title: iMath
description: iMath is a tool for performing various image mathematical operations on medical images, specifically supporting operations on 2D, 3D, and 4D data.

image_dimension.description: Dimensionality of the image, either 2, 3, or 4.
image_dimension.title: Image Dimension

output_image.description: Path for the output image file.
output_image.title: Output Image

operations.description: Operations to be performed along with parameters, e.g., GetLargestComponent, MC for Closing, etc.
operations.title: Operations

image2.description: Second input image file, if required by operation.
image2.title: Input Image 2
